subject: Seventh-tier Wimborne Town knock League Two Crawley out of the FA Cup
title: Seventh-tier Wimborne knock out Crawley

lines.vo: A part-time Dorset side just knocked out a League Two club.
Wimborne Town are fifty-seven places below Crawley. Crawley are bottom of League Two. Let that sink in.
Yang Seung-woo scored after nine minutes. That left Crawley eighty-one minutes to respond.
The interim boss, Kevin Blackwell, made three half-time changes. Then Jackson King's shot went in off Cameron Munn, about eleven minutes from time.
Second season running, Crawley lost to non-league opposition in the Cup. Boreham Wood did it last year.
The FA Cup is a trapdoor, and Crawley keep stepping on it.
